purpose: Current-revision CH3 retrospective candidate diagnostic. NOT point-in-time, historically tradable, out-of-sample, or an account backtest.
history_already_seen: Prior 35-row preflight used old lifecycle queues; its 4/8 changes are not carried forward. Historical strategy outcomes have been seen in prior work, so this is not blind preregistration.

formula.model: simple stock month return - rf_mon = intercept + bM*mktrf + bS*SMB + bV*VMG + epsilon
formula.residual: observed excess return minus full fitted value including intercept
formula.raw_control: product(1 + simple stock month return[m-12..m-2])-1; exactly same CH3 known support for consumer comparison
formula.scaling_diagnostic: mean(raw excess return[m-12..m-2])/sample_sd(same 11 raw excess months); explanatory only, not a fourth consumer
formula.fast: FAST is a separate, unchanged identity, absent from these queues. No merged shared-slot claims.

availability.endpoints: 37 shared-market month-end closes, exact dates, no fill; positive finite native close/raw_close/adjustment_factor; real eligible non-invalid non-synthetic endpoints; close = raw*adjustment; single source identity over whole span
availability.insufficient_history: UNKNOWN; no zero substitution, no low-score interpretation
availability.returns: Native adjusted-close return proxy, not certified total shareholder return
availability.clock: m-1 required by regression even though score excludes m-1. Historical publication availability remains UNKNOWN.
availability.universe: Existing current static pool and industry mapping, not PIT reconstructed

queue.baseline: Preserve source queue ranks and source selected K per window/day/sector
queue.unknown: Keep every original UNKNOWN slot. Permute only known original slots.
queue.known_sort: score descending, original PVR descending, sid ascending
queue.budget: Same original K; no reallocations or account budget

stages.first: All candidate mathematical availability, rank/member changes, disagreement with same-clock raw momentum. Feature seal before labels.
stages.second: Independent audit of clock/future perturbation/source/label identity, then attach original selected opportunity labels only. Report >=50% original tail retention plus entire original return distribution; no new entrant payoff transplant.
stages.third: Only if mechanism and coverage justify and independent audit passes, one separately frozen finite per-stock lifecycle comparison using original exit/fees. Not launched by this script.

constraints: No claiming monthly long-short evidence proves daily entry win rate
